name: FE Civil Prep: Girdlark
subtitle: FE Civil practice, mocks, labs
shortDescription: FE Civil practice that adapts to you: every knowledge area, 1,093 original questions, labs, calculators, 110-question timed mocks and a study plan.
longDescription:
Prepare for the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) Civil exam with Girdlark: a personal study coach that follows the official knowledge areas, checks what you know, and sends you to exactly the lesson, lab or question set you need next.

### What Is Inside
- All 14 knowledge areas and all 79 lettered subtopics of the current exam specification (July 2020 edition), each with a short lesson, a worked example and common traps.
- 1,093 original practice questions: 848 computed numeric problems (every answer checked two independent ways) plus scenario questions for ethics, materials, construction and more. Instant working and a "why not" note for the wrong choice you picked.
- Adaptive practice: quizzes build a private model of your strengths on your device; missed questions come back, and each set ends with links to the lessons and labs to study next, with a line explaining why.
- Two ways to learn, one tap apart: Syllabus (the official order) and Real-World (ten things to build or decide, such as sizing a floor beam, checking a retaining wall, piping a culvert, closing a survey lot, comparing bridge decks, planning a build, sizing a footing, designing a highway curve, treating town water, pumping uphill). Each step teaches only what it needs, then checks your number.
- Eight interactive labs: force polygon, beam shear and moment, Mohr's circle, effective stress, column buckling, open-channel flow, traverse closure and detention pond.
- Seventeen unit-aware calculators for SI and US customary units, and a 311-entry formula index written from first principles, with a find-it drill.
- Timed mock exams that follow the official blueprint: 110 questions in 6 hours, review screen, results by knowledge area and a personal study plan. A free 22-question mini mock is included.
- Coverage screen showing every subtopic, its questions and your progress. Text size 50% to 300% (A-/A+), phone and tablet layouts, works fully offline, no account. Optional usage sharing, diagnostics and feedback are under Me, Settings, Privacy and data.

### Important
Girdlark is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by NCEES. "FE" and "NCEES" are named only to describe the exam this app helps you prepare for. The FE Reference Handbook is not included. The calculators are study tools, not an NCEES-approved exam calculator. Questions are original and do not predict your exam result.
